summary: Treat contents of allowlisted runtime caches as disposable when pruning merged worktrees

delivery.outcome: Merged canonical worktrees under a terminal lease prune when Git lists the contents of an allowlisted runtime root (self-ignoring .ruff_cache, partly ignored .planfile, nested .subactor runtime dirs) instead of the root itself.
nonGoals: No change to lease phases, process checks or forced removal
No new allowlisted roots; .subactor/snapshots, leases and unknown ignored files stay preserved
No target repository edits inside this Governance Hub

architecture.decision: is_safe_ignored_runtime_path accepts any ignored entry whose first component is an allowlisted top-level runtime root, or whose first two components are .subactor/<safe runtime dir>. Only the exact ignored entries Git lists are removed, so tracked files below a root are never deleted.
architecture.rollback: Revert through protected review; the allowlist returns to single-component roots.

validation.evidence: A released merged checkout whose cache carries its own '*' ignore file prunes without --force; nested .subactor runtime entries are disposable.
.subactor snapshots, leases and manifest, .env and runtime-named directories below other paths stay preserved; Governance Hub gate passes.
